summary: Validated backend + frontend for the reported visit-linked operation display issue. Regression pytest passed (5/5), targeted API assertion for vehicle 1060/توضيب مكينة passed, and UI verification confirmed partial status + corrected notes/labels on the operation card.

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent preview flakiness observed during automation (some runs showed 0 cards temporarily before succeeding on retry). Final verification run passed with 12 operations loaded.

action_items: Optional hardening: investigate intermittent preview-time operations fetch/render race causing occasional 0-card state in automation.
critical_code_review_comments: Operations.jsx and supabase_service.py remain very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk and slowing targeted debugging; modular split is recommended.
Targeted payment/notes sanitization logic now behaves correctly for visit-linked partial payments (validated via API and UI).
seed_data_creation: No seed data created; tested against existing preview dataset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified target operation card (vehicle 1060 / ايسوزو ونيت / توضيب مكينة) shows مدفوع جزئياً, totalPaid 300, balance 2000, and notes عملية من الزيارة 001 with no raw short visit id. Regression test file iteration_207 remains green (5/5).
rca of the issue: Original bug was caused by payment/status derivation and raw visit-id leakage in operation display paths. Current implementation correctly derives operation payment snapshot from operation total vs totalPaid and sanitizes visit note display. Residual risk is intermittent preview loading behavior, not a deterministic business-logic failure.
